language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi! My name is Ivaar and this is my mom, Sonja. We live in Norway. My mom and I like to go hiking in the mountains.
My mom and I saw many plants and flowers on our hike today. Since it's so cold in the Arctic region, plants in this habitat have adapted to survive here by finding ways to protect against the cold.
One way this bearberry plant adapts is that it has leathery leaves to protect itself from the cold and wind.
Today my mom and I are working on a Plant Adaptation Science project for school. Can you help me gather information to complete my project?
Let’s go hiking in the mountains!
Hi! My name is Ivaar and this is my mom, Sonja. We live in Norway. My mom and I like to go hiking in the mountains.
My mom and I saw many plants and flowers on our hike today. Since it's so cold in the Arctic region, plants in this habitat have adapted to survive here by finding ways to protect against the cold.
One way this bearberry plant adapts is that it has leathery leaves to protect itself from the cold and wind.
Today my mom and I are working on a Plant Adaptation Science project for school. Can you help me gather information to complete my project?
Let’s go hiking in the mountains!
Plants need air, water, sunlight, and food to survive. So they adapt to be able to fulfill these needs.
Plants also need to reproduce to make new plants and they adapt to make new plants too!
The first part of my project is to make a chart which shows what adaptations are needed in different situations.
Can you pick the right answer to tell me how plants adapt to each need?
